_comment: Lean hooks: the full doctrine + routing map live in CLAUDE.md (auto-loaded by Claude Code and covered by the ~1h prompt cache), so they are NOT re-injected on every message. setup.sh generates these hooks and writes CLAUDE.md for you.

hooks.command: printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"MANDATORY FIRST ACTIONS (every model, before responding): call Skill `caveman` (full mode), `pentesting-agent`, and `validator` (preload), then read the MEMORY.md index. Full doctrine + routing map are in CLAUDE.md at the project root (already auto-loaded, prompt-cached) so they are not repeated here. If the model changes mid-session, re-invoke the three skills."}}'

printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"UserPromptSubmit","additionalContext":"Every message, every model: DEFAULT TO PAL for each task — bulk read/extract/summarize to nemotron/flash, report-writing/vuln-explanation/validation to groq (full routing + keep-in-Claude list in CLAUDE.md). Pre-filter recon output locally first (bin/sauron-normalize, bin/strip-noise). Failover on refusal, never stop."}}'
